static_traits.name: Lin Kailin
static_traits.occupation: Marketing professional (also running an online store)
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members in the city
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends, but unwilling to talk about business-related self-doubt, feeling somewhat isolated due to anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: Without similar psychological problem history; has not yet received psychological counseling; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: High cooperation, clear and organized expression, able to recognize and describe emotions and bodily reactions; willing to record triggering situations and thoughts, overall communication smooth

basic_info.main_problem: Persistent self-doubt and inadequacy about the ability to run the online business, worsening especially in the morning when there are no customers, and affecting work motivation and efficiency.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling to address the negative impact of self-doubt on online-business work motivation and efficiency, learning to evaluate situations more balancedly and change negative thinking.

core_beliefs: I am destined not to succeed (as a shop owner)

special_situations.event: The whole morning with no customers / orders
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there are no customers for a short time, it proves I am not fit to be a shop owner, my ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sinking into rumination and self-doubt, reducing actual action; trying to force myself to stay 'positive' but with limited effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot hold on any longer, I am not fit to be a shop owner

special_situations.event: Slow-business periods (mornings or days starting poorly)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must continuously have customers to count as performing well, otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing attention on the negative cue of 'no customers', ignoring other business metrics and controllable tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one is interested in my products

special_situations.event: After a morning with no customers, still no obvious progress during the day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the start is not good now, it will only get worse next
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Anticipating failure leads to decreased engagement, postponing or reducing improvement attempts

special_situations.event: Checking business performance when sales are low
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Poor sales fully indicate that I personally am not capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Blaming oneself and avoiding discussing with friends to avoid appearing incompetent

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be affirmed as capable and able to run a business successfully
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being negated as incompetent, afraid that failure brings shame and being judged
defense_goal: Maintains self-control and bears things alone to avoid external evaluation
Avoids asking others for help and disclosing vulnerability to reduce shame

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, a possibly-failing entrepreneur / practitioner
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges or uninterested others and customers

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked in counseling or daily life whether they confide in friends or seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that once difficulties are exposed, one will be seen as incompetent, like being harshly judged and not accepted
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Evasively avoiding deep vulnerable details, emphasizing 'I am not used to troubling others', restrained tone, focusing on general strategies rather than personal vulnerable experiences.

manifestations: Though having a few friends, unwilling to discuss business-related self-doubt, choosing to bear it alone
Reducing use of social support due to worry and shame, subjectively feeling isolated

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worried about being judged, not confiding in or seeking help from friends
Attributing poor sales entirely to oneself, excessive self-blame, and tightening contact with others

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Could have sought emotional support and advice from friends, but instead bears it alone with harsh self-blame
When external feedback is needed, chooses to keep it bottled up and internalizes it as self-criticism

positive_force: Performance in daily work (marketing position) is generally stable, with a relevant professional background
Clear motivation to seek help, willing to record and notice triggering situations and automatic thoughts
Able to recognize emotions and bodily reactions, willing to try restructuring and positive reappraisal
Has a certain social network (a few close friends); potential support resources can be activated
negative_force: Significant self-doubt, with overgeneralization, mental filtering, predicting the future, personalization and other cognitive biases
Increased rumination, occupying action time, weakening problem solving and execution
Sleep disturbed, leading to decreased energy and focus, forming a negative cycle
Unwilling to disclose distress to friends, insufficient use of social support, increased subjective sense of isolation

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated rumination and worry, leading to decreased work motivation and executive avoidance
antecedent: Mornings or days starting with no customers / orders
Business overall in a slow period
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing the short-term absence of customers and overgeneralizing it into long-term failure, personalizing attribution reinforcing self-doubt
target_behavior.function: Short-term escape from uncertainty and failure feelings, gaining temporary self-comfort and sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Reducing actual action and attempts, declining business efficiency and creativity, further validating the negative belief of 'being incompetent'

target_behavior.behavior: Difficulty falling asleep and ruminating in bed (sleep affected by anxiety)
antecedent: Recalling the customer-less day at night or worrying about business prospects
Before sleep, focuses on negative business data or self-evaluation
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative predictions about business prospects and self-deprecation activate anxiety, unable to stop thinking
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain a sense of control or find the 'perfect solution' through continuous thinking, briefly relieving uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality, next-day energy and impaired concentration, daytime work efficiency reduced
